title: Dropbox sync folder
whyItMatters: Everything the person keeps in Dropbox is also on this disk, readable without any password. The folder names alone show their work and private life.
source: Arch Wiki, Dropbox: the desktop client syncs to ~/Dropbox by default and keeps its state in ~/.dropbox: https://wiki.archlinux.org/title/Dropbox
notes: Dropbox asks for the sync location during setup and it can be changed later, so this is the default only. Business accounts may use a named folder instead. The account and folder list live in ~/.dropbox, which this rule does not count.
